description: This file defines Express.js routes related to user notifications, including fetching notifications, marking them as read, and simulating test notifications.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all notifications for the current user using JWT authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/:id/read')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to mark a specific notification as read.

methods.name: router.post('/simulate')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to simulate a test notification for frontend polling testing.
